scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('.feed-post-title a[href]').each((i,e)=>{const a=$(e);let href=a.attr('href');if(!href)return;posts.push({url:href,title:a.text().trim(),publishedAt:a.closest('article,.post').find('time').first().attr('datetime')||null});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const title=$('.post > h2').first().text().trim();const author=$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('[rel="author"]').first().text().trim()||null;const publishedAt=$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null;const body=$('.post .content').first().clone();body.find('script,style,noscript,nav,footer,.header-anchor,.upvote-form,.post-footer,.toc,.table-of-contents').remove();return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author,publishedAt,tags:$('[rel="tag"]').map((i,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()};}
scraper.notes: Live fetchHtml https://yuzhou.life/ redirects to https://yuzhou.my/ with same Yuzhou’s Playground identity. Homepage .feed-post-title a lists multilingual dated posts; article .post > h2 title and .post .content body. Original URL preserved as originalHome.
